description: This file defines the OceanTheme class, which provides theming configurations for a Flutter app. It includes color constants, a ThemeData configuration for light mode, and utility widgets for background gradient and max width container.

classes.name: OceanTheme
classes.description: A utility class providing color constants, theme configuration, and layout widgets for consistent app theming.

methods.name: light
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData object configured for light mode with custom colors, app bar, card, input decoration, and chip themes.

methods.name: gradientBackground
methods.description: A widget that wraps its child in a Container with a linear gradient background for decorative purposes.

methods.name: maxWidthContainer
methods.description: A widget that constrains its child's maximum width to 900 pixels or less, centering the child for wide screens.
